verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both break the headline into five one-word lines, set the legal fine print at nearly the size of the subhead, and pack the subhead, CTA and legal text into the bottom third, with the legal text tight against the bottom edge, while the bottle area above has generous space. A's SOLSTICE wordmark at the top is a little smaller and harder to read than B's, so B keeps the brand slightly better.
